name: Reis-Bücklers Corneal Dystrophy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Histopathological Diagnostic Criteria for Reis-Bücklers Corneal Dystrophy

criteria.description: Presence of bilateral, symmetric, geographic subepithelial corneal opacities primarily affecting Bowman's layer
Histopathological evidence of replacement of Bowman's layer by fibrous tissue with characteristic rod-shaped deposits
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the TGFBI gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Bilateral characteristic corneal opacities with histopathological confirmation or identification of pathogenic TGFBI mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by histopathology and genetic testing when available.

common.symptomName: Decreased visual acuity due to corneal scarring
searchTerms: reduced eyesight due to corneal damage
visual loss caused by corneal scarring

common.symptomName: Ocular discomfort or foreign body sensation
searchTerms: eye irritation or feeling something in eye
ocular discomfort or foreign body sensation

laboratory: Histopathology showing replacement of Bowman's layer by fibrous tissue with rod-shaped deposits
imaging: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy revealing characteristic geographic subepithelial opacities
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing Bowman's layer disruption
other: Family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of map-like and fingerprint-like opacities rather than geographic opacities
Later onset and milder recurrent erosions
Amyloid deposits forming lattice lines in corneal stroma
Different genetic mutations in TGFBI gene

redFlags: Severe recurrent corneal erosions causing intense pain
Signs of secondary infection such as corneal ulceration or perforation
references: Klintworth GK. Corneal dystrophies. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2009;4:7.
Weiss JS, Møller HU, Lisch W, et al. IC3D classification of corneal dystrophies--edition 2. Cornea. 2015;34(2):117-159.
